description: This file implements the DeviceInfo plugin for WPEFramework, providing system information and device details via a web interface. It includes initialization, deinitialization, request processing, and system info retrieval functions, and references other system components and interfaces.

classes.name: DeviceInfo
classes.description: Main class implementing device information retrieval for the plugin, including initialization, request processing, and system info gathering functions.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the DeviceInfo plugin with a given service, setting up necessary system interfaces and state.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Releases resources and cleans up the plugin state when deinitialized.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a string representing plugin information; currently returns an empty string.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound Web requests; no implementation needed for now.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes incoming Web requests, particularly GET requests to retrieve device/system info, and constructs the appropriate JSON response.

methods.name: SysInfo
methods.description: Populates system information data structure with current system metrics.

methods.name: AddressInfo
methods.description: Gathers network interface addresses and MACs, populating the provided address info array.

methods.name: SocketPortInfo
methods.description: Populates socket and port information, including resource monitor status.
